# vessel

> Local-first observability proxy for LLM traffic. Capture, search, replay, and compare every prompt across Ollama, OpenAI, and Anthropic backends. One binary, no account, nothing leaves your machine.

vessel sits between your LLM clients and any backend. Point a base URL at it and every request is captured live: prompts, responses, timing, token counts. Search it, replay it against other models, score what comes back. MIT licensed.

- [Homepage](https://vesselproxy.app/)
- [README](https://github.com/spenceclark/Vessel#readme)
- [Releases](https://github.com/spenceclark/Vessel/releases/latest)
